record.prompt: Please run the September 2026 report (scripts/monthly.sh 2026-09) and tell me the total. Don't change the script itself.
record.final_answer:
The September 2026 total is **5437.50**.

The first run failed because the `out/` directory didn't exist, and the script writes its result to `out/total-2026-09.txt`. I created `out/` without touching the script, and the second run worked. I also added up the five rows in `data/2026-09.csv` by hand (1250.00 + 380.50 + 2210.75 + 96.25 + 1500.00) and got the same total.

The only change in the repo is the new `out/` directory with that output file in it. Git doesn't track empty directories, so on a fresh checkout the script will fail the same way until `out/` is created.
